confidence_flags: This sheet packs many small unrelated details onto one page at small scale (an arched beam formwork detail, two L-shaped edge sections, a stepped-down slab detail, an awning wall-mount detail, a floor-to-balcony joint detail, plus the three slab types S0/S1/S1a and a corner rebar-bend detail). Several small handwritten Thai labels were not fully legible even at 2x zoom — transcribed what was clearly readable; left uncertain readings out rather than guessing.
warnings: 'S0'/'S1'/'S1a' here are the rebar SPECS for the slab markers of the same name seen on the beam plans (หน้า19/20) — join by element_id per §7.

The arched beam detail ('แบบขยาย_2') matches the curved bay/oriel beam recorded approximately on the ground-floor beam plan (หน้า19, B3 between ~B7-~C7) — this sheet gives its stirrup spacing (RB9@0.15 along the arch, RB9@0.20 at the springs) but does not give a plan position/span, so it does not resolve that beam's grid_ref ambiguity.
